run_MARL_training: run the PyMARL multi-agent RL training loop with config, logger, and sacred experiment tracking
run_sequential_training: run sequential multi-agent RL training episodes with replay buffer sampling and periodic model saving
evaluate_MARL_model: evaluate a trained multi-agent RL model by running test episodes and optionally saving replay data
load_checkpoint_model: load a PyMARL model checkpoint from a specified path and resume training or evaluation
sanity_check_config: validate and sanitize PyMARL config arguments including CUDA availability and test episode alignment
